summary.analysis_type: TreeSHAP Global and Local Probability Attribution Analysis

e0.methodology: Per-record additive combination: Delta_S(x_k) = sum_{j in S} phi_{k, j}. Because expectation is linear, the population mean combined contribution identically equals the sum of the population mean marginal SHAP values: E[Delta_S] = sum_{j in S} E[phi_j].

e4.methodology: Per-record additive combination: Delta_S(x_k) = sum_{j in S} phi_{k, j}. Because expectation is linear, the population mean combined contribution identically equals the sum of the population mean marginal SHAP values: E[Delta_S] = sum_{j in S} E[phi_j].

summary.interaction_observational_finding: E4 exhibits a different interaction structure, with DomainLength appearing prominently among the largest interaction pairs. This is an observed difference between the frozen ensembles and is consistent with a change in learned feature interactions. The analysis does not establish that synthetic augmentation alone caused this difference.
